schema_amendments.description: S3 is a READ-ONLY sprint at the schema layer. ZERO new tables, ZERO new columns, ZERO new constraints, ZERO new indexes, ZERO migrations. The dashboard, sales report, and carry-forward verification all consume entities and indexes already shipped in S1 (master tables) + S2 (transaction tables + tbl_stock_ledger). The S2 composite index ix_stock_ledger_dgt(design_id, grade_id, txn_date DESC, ledger_id DESC) was explicitly designed to also service S3's dashboard aggregation (see S2 schema.json comment on that index); S3 now exercises that prior intent. The S2 indexes ix_sales_header_sales_date, ix_sales_header_dealer, ix_sales_line_dgd were similarly forward-declared for S3 Sales Report and now come into use.

entities.name: tbl_stock_ledger

fields.name: ledger_id
fields.description: PK. Existing — see S2 schema.json. NOT modified.

fields.name: design_id
fields.description: Existing — partition key for the dashboard CASE-aggregated SUM (DS-016).

fields.name: grade_id
fields.description: Existing — partition key for the dashboard CASE-aggregated SUM (DS-016).

fields.name: txn_date
fields.description: Existing — date-range predicate for dashboard month-window scan (txn_date BETWEEN :month_start AND :as_of_date).

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Existing — CASE branch key for dashboard SUM (inward / sale / adjustment).

fields.name: delta
fields.description: Existing — summed within CASE branches; the 'sale' branch sums -delta so the outward column reads positive (DS-016).

fields.name: running_balance
fields.description: Existing — read by opening_balance + closing_balance for O(1) per-pair latest_as_of lookups (DS-003/004).

indexes: ix_stock_ledger_dgt(design_id, grade_id, txn_date DESC, ledger_id DESC) — EXISTING from S2/T-042. Services the S3 dashboard date-range scan (Index Range Scan on the (design_id, grade_id) prefix + txn_date) AND continues to service S2's closing_balance / latest_for_design_grade / rows_after lookups. No new index needed.
design_notes: DS-015 amends DS-002 to mandate pg_advisory_xact_lock-before-FOR-UPDATE pattern on WRITES. S3 only READS so DS-015 has no direct effect on S3 code — but documenting it here keeps the lock contract visible to any S3 reviewer who wonders why ledger writes look layered.

DS-016: the single CASE-aggregated SUM over a date range uses ix_stock_ledger_dgt — the (design_id, grade_id) prefix groups; the txn_date suffix limits the in-window slice. No additional index required.

entities.name: tbl_sales_header

fields.name: header_id
fields.description: Existing PK. Joined to sales_line in both consolidation + transaction queries.

fields.name: sales_date
fields.description: Existing — date-range filter predicate via build_filter() (DS-017). Used in transaction-row ORDER BY ASC per RULE-020.

fields.name: dealer_id
fields.description: Existing — dealer multi-select filter predicate via build_filter() (DS-017).

fields.name: place
fields.description: Existing — denormalized snapshot per DS-013. Used directly in transaction-row projection AND in place multi-select filter via build_filter() (DS-017).

indexes: ix_sales_header_sales_date — EXISTING from S2/T-042. Services the AC-046 date-range filter for both queries.
ix_sales_header_dealer — EXISTING from S2/T-042. Services the AC-046 dealer-id filter for both queries.

NOTE: there is NO index on tbl_sales_header.place. Place filtering may fall back to a sequential scan when place is the only filter applied. Acceptable for V1 volumes (single-digit concurrent users, V1 scale) per PRD non_functional.scalability. If profiling at V1 shows place-only filters dominating the report mix, add ix_sales_header_place in V2.
used_by_s3_files: backend/src/application/services/sales_report_service.py (both consolidation + transactions queries via shared build_filter())
design_notes: DS-017 enforces AC-050 by construction — the same filter predicate object is .where()-applied to both consolidation and transactions queries, so divergent filter rows are structurally impossible.

fields.name: map_id
fields.description: Existing PK.

fields.description: Existing — joined for active-pair enumeration.

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Existing — filtered to true in DesignGradeMapRepository.list_active_all (new method this sprint, reads only this column + design/grade).

indexes: ux_design_grade_map_pair UNIQUE (design_id, grade_id) — EXISTING from S1.
Implicit B-tree from UNIQUE supports the list_active_all WHERE is_active scan; at V1 scale (~6 rows after seed, growing slowly) a seq scan is also acceptable. No new index required.

backend/src/application/services/dashboard_service.py (consumes list_active_all to enumerate the dashboard row-set)
design_notes: list_active_all is a small extension of list_active_by_design from S1 — drops the design_id filter, keeps the .design + .grade lazy='joined' hydration so design_name/size/grade_code reach the DashboardRow projection without N+1.

fields.name: is_active

entities.name: tbl_dealer_master

fields.name: dealer_id
fields.description: Existing PK. JOIN target for sales report transaction-row dealer_name projection.

fields.name: dealer_name
fields.description: Existing — projected into TransactionRow.dealer_name.

design_notes: Sales report ONLY reads dealer.dealer_name for the transaction-row projection. place is read from tbl_sales_header.place (denormalized snapshot per DS-013) — not from the dealer master — so historical sales rows display the place that was in effect at sale time, even if the dealer record's place is later updated.

sales_report_service.py -> tbl_sales_header + tbl_sales_line + tbl_trading_design_master + tbl_grade_master + tbl_dealer_master

migration_plan.rationale: S3 introduces no schema changes. Existing migrations 0001 (master tables) + 0002 (master indexes) + 0003 (transaction + ledger tables with all indexes pre-declared for S3 reuse) are sufficient. No alembic revision created for S3.

indexes_in_play_summary.index: ix_stock_ledger_dgt(design_id, grade_id, txn_date DESC, ledger_id DESC)

s3_uses: AC-046 date-range filter for both consolidation + transaction queries
AC-046 dealer multi-select filter for both queries
AC-047 GROUP BY design_id, grade_id in consolidation
JOIN sales_line -> sales_header in both queries
place-only filter falls back to seq scan — acceptable at V1 scale per PRD non_functional.scalability. Documented gap; V2 candidate.
